faqs.question: What Markdown syntax is supported?
faqs.answer: This tool supports standard Markdown including headings (#, ##), bold (**text**), italic (*text*), lists, code blocks (```), inline code, links, images, blockquotes, and GitHub Flavored Markdown (GFM) tables.

faqs.question: Can I use this to preview README files?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paste the contents of any README.md or documentation file and see exactly how it will render on GitHub or other Markdown platforms.

faqs.question: Is my text saved anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. Everything stays in your browser. Your Markdown is never sent to any server.
